Maya: FYI kicking off deploy for edge-proxy now. Feature flag rollout plan for `session-affinity-v2` — quick sanity check before canary.
Maya: Plan: enable for internal cohort `canary-crew` at 1% (t0). After 10m -> 10%, after 30m -> 50%, after 2h -> 100% (if no safety signals).
Maya: Sticky sessions via user_id hash; dedupe header on. Rollback criteria: absolute 5xx delta > 0.3% sustained for 5m OR p95 latency up >100ms OR routing error rate >0.2% for 3m.
Maya: Commands I'll run:
```
/ff set session-affinity-v2 enable --cohort=canary-crew --percent=1
/deploy start edge-proxy --tag v2.3.1-canary --owner @Maya
```
Maya: Observability dash: https://ops.redwood/edge-proxy/canary (watch 5xx, p95, model-routing-errors). Runbook: /runbooks/edge-proxy-canary.md. Quiet window 02:00-04:00 UTC tonight.
Tom: ack. I'll watch telemetry and the P95 tail. If P95 jumps >50ms for 2 consecutive 5m buckets call rollback.
Ivy: adding release note blurb and changelog entry. Suggest we pin model-routing to v3.0.2 for the canary to avoid double variables.
Ben: small ask — ensure dedupe header is on to avoid sticky collisions from probes. Also confirm the GRACEFUL_UNWIND flag is off.
SRE Oncall: I'm on deck first 30m. Our escalation threshold: 5xx > 0.4% for 5m -> immediate rollback. Will open an incident channel if triggered.
deploy-bot: [1719992230] Started canary: edge-proxy v2.3.1-canary, cohort=canary-crew, percent=1.
Maya: pinning model-routing to v3.0.2 for the canary now.
Maya: running `/ff set ...` now.
deploy-bot: [1719992242] Feature flag update applied: session-affinity-v2 -> cohort(canary-crew)=1% (actor=Maya)
Maya: extra debug kv-cache logging enabled for first 20m.
deploy-bot: [1719992255] Canary metrics snapshot: 5xx=0.02%, p95 latency = +8ms vs baseline, model-routing-errors=0.00%.
Tom: looks clean so far. Recommend ramp to 10% at +10m unless we see signal.
Ivy: +1 on ramp. I'm publishing the release notes draft and tagging `relnotes/edge-v2.3.1`.
Ben: verified dedupe header; re-checking sticky session hashes against canary users.
SRE Oncall: noted. If any of the rollback criteria trip, use `/ff set session-affinity-v2 disable --all` and run `deploy rollback edge-proxy --to v2.3.0`.
Maya: ramp to 10% in ~8m then 50% at +30m if green. Will post a follow-up at each step.
Tom: also watch token cost spike on this route; if token consumption increases >15% hold the ramp.
Ivy: tagging marketing for the staged enable (cc @marketing in the release thread).
Maya: thanks team, proceeding. :rocket:
